# WS-03 builder brief: orchestrator, stages, retries, heartbeats, sweeper, prewarm, early workers

Store root for every `internal/...` and `docs/...` path: `/cursor/stores/bc-5bc79926-909c-4cfb-aa62-24b3a44735e2`. Repo paths are relative to the checkout of `huntertcarver/house-scanning-server`. Plan: `docs/server-pipeline-build-plan.md` §6 "WS-03". Names, enums, models and artifact keys follow `docs/build/ws-00-skeleton-and-contracts.md` (WS-00 §3.8–§3.12, as amended by `docs/build/decisions.md`, cited as `SD-nn`) and are not redefined here; sibling interfaces come from `docs/build/ws-0{2,4,5,6,8,9}-*.md` and `ws-10-result-and-ar.md`. `[default chosen]` marks a choice the plan or code left open; every one is listed in `internal/build/layout-decisions-ws-03.md`, with the cross-brief inconsistencies (resolved in `internal/build/decision-log-group-a.md`). Timing and cost facts come from `internal/breadth/B3-cheap-gate.md` (B3) and `internal/context-dumps/full/b2-equipment-reading.md` (B2).

## 0. Card

- **WS-03, orchestrator.** Goal: turn a finalized capture into a verdict by running WS-00's eleven stages on Modal (`.spawn()` per stage, the `stages` table with heartbeats, a 5-min sweeper, GPU escalation, 20-min hard stop, the `merge_objects` join), start meter and panel reads, image QA with the CLIP+SigLIP gate scores, and ARKit-pose coverage hints as early workers at file commit, prewarm the GPU at capture creation, and emit the `stage`, `hint`, `capture_check` and `failed` events the device long-polls.
- Builder model: Grok 4.7. Validator: a separate agent (any model), never the builder.
- Inputs: hook calls from WS-01 (`server/api`); `StateStore`, `Storage`, `Settings`, `jobs.py` models from WS-00 (SD-15/17, no subclassing); `server.<stage>.run(ctx)` from WS-02..WS-10 (stubs until they land); `read_still` (WS-08; returns the meter identity and writes `early/meter_identity.json`, SD-46), `capture_check` (WS-02), `score_frame` (WS-07), `merge_objects` (WS-06), copy table (WS-10).
- Outputs: `RunRecord`, `StageRecord`, `EventRecord` rows; `captures/{captureId}/runs/{runId}/run/{timings.json,cost.json,stages.json}` (WS-00 §3.9, → WS-11/12); early blobs under `captures/{captureId}/early/`; `RunRecord.artifacts` naming every stage output; the `Pipeline` GPU class and the Modal functions on WS-00's `app` that WS-12 deploys (SD-32). Consumed by WS-01 (`GET /events`, `GET /captures/{id}`, `GET /result`), WS-10, WS-11 (replay, `make e2e`), WS-12 (deploy).
- Repo `huntertcarver/house-scanning-server`, branch `ws-03/orchestrator`, one PR. No contracts PR: the additive fields WS-03 needs are already in WS-00's `jobs.py`/`state.py` (SD-15/17).

## 3. Interfaces

Units: seconds (`_s`), UTC ISO-8601 (`_at`), USD floats (`_usd`), metres for hint geometry. Ids: `captureId` from WS-01; `run_id = "run_" + sha256(packet.json bytes)[:16]` (hosted-architecture §2.2: same SHA → same run; a different SHA on one capture is WS-01's 409 `packet_sha_conflict`) `[default chosen]`.

Job state machine. Two levels, both WS-00 enums: `CaptureRecord.status` (device-visible) and `RunRecord.status` / `StageRecord.status` (`StageStatus`).

```
capture: processing ──run done──▶ complete | needs_views | manual_review        (written by WS-10's result stage, §4.8)
                    ──§4.8 failure route──▶ manual_review | failed              (written by the coordinator)
run:     pending ──coordinator spawned──▶ running ──all required stages done──▶ done
                                            ├──▶ failed  (required stage exhausted, hard stop, spend cap, invalid artifact)
                                            └──▶ skipped (cancel_capture)
stage:   pending ──spawn──▶ running ──▶ done | failed (failures ≥ max_attempts or respawns > 2) | skipped
         running ──heartbeat > 180 s old──▶ stale ──cancel, respawns += 1──▶ pending
         running ──error, timeout──▶ pending (failures += 1)                 attempt = failures + respawns + 1
```

State lives in WS-00's records (SD-17): `RunRecord` carries `deadline_at`, `degraded`, `failure_code`, `outcome_kind`, `spend_usd: {gpu, cpu, vlm_reads, vlm_objects, vlm_c3}`; `StageRecord` carries `failures`, `respawns`, `worker_call_id`, `substep`, `error_code`, `error = "<code>: <message>"`, `metrics {duration_s, enter_s, vlm_cost_usd}`. Only the coordinator-private fields live in `blob:run_control:{run_id}` (`RunControl {coordinator_call_id, coordinator_heartbeat_at, coordinator_respawns: int, cancel_requested: bool, prewarmed: bool, final_event_seq: int | None}`); `max_attempts` and `timeout_s` are static in the graph spec. The state store is WS-00's `StateStore` obtained from `resolve_state(settings)` (SD-15: `runs_for_capture`, `list_runs`, `get_stage`, `stages`, `heartbeat`, `set_status`, `put_blob`/`get_blob`/`list_blobs`, `add_spend`); this WS defines no state class.

Dict keys (WS-00 §3.10 prefixes owned by this WS): `run:{run_id}`, `runs_by_capture:{capture_id}`, `stage:{run_id}:{stage}`, `event:{capture_id}:{seq:020d}`, `blob:{key}`, `spend:{scope}`. `seq = max(prev + 1, time.time_ns() // 1000)`, strictly increasing per capture; Postgres uses a per-capture sequence `[default chosen]`. `modal.Dict` has no compare-and-swap, so only the coordinator writes run and stage transitions and `set_status` after finalize; workers write `heartbeat` and `blob:*`; the µs clock makes the remaining early-worker `seq` race harmless. `tests/test_state_contract.py` runs WS-00's contract against `memory` and, with a token, `modal_dict`.

Stage graph (`graph.py`, `STAGES: dict[StageName, StageSpec]`; `where` = CPU function or GPU class; `optional` = failure degrades the run instead of failing it; entry = `server.<stage>.run(ctx)` per WS-00 §3.12, `objects_3d` = `server.objects.run_3d(ctx)`; artifact keys = WS-00 §3.9 paths under `runs/{runId}/`, SD-01…SD-08):

| stage | deps | where | timeout_s | max_attempts (gpu by attempt) | optional | owner | artifacts it publishes (`RunRecord.artifacts` keys) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `validate` | – | cpu | 60 | 2 | no | WS-02 | `packet/validation.json`, `packet/normalized.json`, `packet/capture_check.json` |
| `poses` | validate | gpu | 420 | 3 (`L4`, `L4`, `A100-40GB`) | no | WS-04 | `poses/cameras.json`, `poses/sparse.ply`, `poses/tracks.npz`, `poses/registration_report.json`, `poses/sparse/0/` |
| `objects` | validate | cpu | 240 | 2 | yes | WS-07 | `objects/objects.json` (2D detections with `views`, SD-06) |
| `reads` | validate | cpu | 420 | 2 | yes | WS-08 | `reads/reads.json` |
| `scale` | poses, reads (terminal) | cpu | 60 | 2 | no | WS-05 | `scale/scale.json` |
| `dense` | poses, scale | gpu | 300 | 3 (`L4`, `L4`, `A100-40GB`) | no | WS-06 | `dense/dense.ply`, `dense/depth/`, `dense/dense_report.json` |
| `coverage` | dense | cpu | 120 | 2 | no | WS-06 | `coverage/coverage.npz`, `coverage/bands.json`, `coverage/points.ply`, `coverage/scene_draft.json` |
| `scene` | coverage, objects (terminal) | cpu | 120 | 2 | no | WS-06 | `scene/scene.json` (+ asset copies), `scene/build_report.json` |
| `objects_3d` | scene, objects | cpu | 120 | 2 | yes | WS-07 | `objects/objects_3d.json` (scene-frame `Object`s, SD-06) |
| `criteria` | scene, reads (terminal), objects_3d (terminal) | cpu | 180 | 2 | no | WS-09 | `verdicts/verdict.{A,B,C,S}.json`, `verdicts/criteria_report.json`, `verdicts/placement.<p>.json` |
| `result` | criteria | cpu | 60 | 2 | no | WS-10 | `result/result.json`, `result/result.internal.json`, `result/review.html`, `result/preview.ply` |

Parallel groups (SD-08): after `validate`, `poses` ∥ `objects` ∥ `reads` start together (hosted-architecture §3 "par geometry / objects"); the geometry chain is `poses → scale → dense → coverage → scene → criteria → result`; `objects` (2D) joins at `scene` (WS-06 lifts the detections onto wall planes) and again at `objects_3d` (3D placement, WS-07, after the scene exists); `reads` joins at `scale` (meter make/model for A9) and `criteria`. Between `objects_3d` and `criteria` the coordinator calls `server.scene.merge_objects(scene_path, objects_3d_path)` (WS-06), which rewrites `scene/scene.json`, then re-runs `python -m server.eval.cli validate` on it (invalid → `artifact_invalid:scene`, §4.8); when `objects_3d` is skipped or failed the unmerged scene goes to `criteria` and the run is degraded. Both GPU stages are methods of one `Pipeline` class so weights load once. `objects` is CPU + API because B3 §1 drops OWLv2 from the cascade ("no better and 13× slower") `[default chosen]`. Frame budget (SD-10, Modal benchmark 22:28: L4 mapper 96 / 186 / 237 s at 40 / 60 / 70 photos): `poses` receives `HSS_POSES_SFM_MAX_FRAMES=48` through `Settings` and thins the SfM set itself; the 420 s timeout is sized for that.

```python
# server/orchestrator/runner.py — uses WS-00's StageContext verbatim (SD-17: heartbeat, deadline_at, gpu, vlm_budget_usd,
#   parent_run_id, models are contract fields); inputs: artifact key → local path, always "packet_dir" and "run_control",
#   plus "parent/<key>" on amendment runs. StageResult: artifacts, metrics, warnings; failures are raised, not returned.
#   metrics the coordinator reads: "vlm_cost_usd", "duration_s", "enter_s".
def run_stage(ctx: StageContext) -> StageResult          # importlib.import_module(f"server.{pkg}").run(ctx) or .run_3d(ctx), or stubs/
RETRYABLE = (RuntimeError, OSError, TimeoutError, "torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError", "modal.exception.*")   # class names; else no retry
```


Events WS-03 emits (`state.append_event(capture_id, type, data, run_id=, stage=)`; `data` = WS-00 `api.py` models, camelCase, SD-19): `hint` (`HintData {code: HintCode, message, retake?, promptId?, frames?}`), `capture_check` (`CaptureCheckData {complete, missing: list[CaptureCheckCode], meterRead?, prompts?}`), `stage` (`StageData {stage, status, attempt, runId, gpu?, durationS?, errorCode?}`), `failed` (`FailedData {code, message, next: manual_review|none}`). `verdict_ready` (`{runId, kind}`) and `retake_request` (`{runId, viewsNeeded, memberActions}`) are emitted by WS-10's `result` stage (its §4.11); the coordinator only checks that exactly one final event exists per run. Codes are WS-00's closed lists (SD-20): this WS emits the hint codes `frames_blurry, frames_dark, frames_overexposed, wall_gap_left, wall_gap_right, ground_not_seen_left, ground_not_seen_right` and relays WS-08's read hints; `capture_check.missing` = WS-02's checklist items plus this WS's pose-frusta codes `wall_left_of_meter, wall_right_of_meter, ground_downward_left, ground_downward_right` (`keyframe_count` is WS-02's item; there is no `too_few_keyframes`). Copy: `server.result.copy` (WS-10; WS-14 catalogue) when importable, else a neutral `message`.

Config: WS-00 `Settings` (`STATE_BACKEND=memory|modal_dict|postgres`, `STATE_DICT_NAME=hss-<env>-state`, `STORAGE_BACKEND`, `MODAL_APP_NAME=house-scanning` (the deployed app that out-of-app callers such as the `run-modal` CLI look functions up in), `SMP_ENVIRONMENT`, `SMP_SERVICE_NAME=pipeline|early-worker|sweeper`, `RULES_PROFILE_DEFAULT=C`, `HARD_STOP_MIN=20`, `CAPTURE_CHECK_TARGET_S=30`, `VISION_EXTERNAL_CALLS=on|off` (`off` disables early reads and the object tier too), `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `XAI_API_KEY`) plus `server/orchestrator/config.py` knobs (SD-11 scheme, env names only): `HSS_ORCH_STAGE_STUBS=0|1`, `HSS_ORCH_HEARTBEAT_S=30`, `HSS_ORCH_STALE_S=180`, `HSS_ORCH_MAX_RESPAWNS=2`, `HSS_ORCH_SWEEPER_PERIOD_MIN=5`, `HSS_ORCH_GPU_PRIMARY=L4`, `HSS_ORCH_GPU_ESCALATE=A100-40GB`, `HSS_ORCH_PREWARM=1`, `HSS_ORCH_MODAL_SPEND_CAP_USD=200`, `HSS_ORCH_GPU_DAILY_CAP_USD=20`, `HSS_ORCH_VLM_RUN_SOFT_USD=0.30`, `HSS_ORCH_VLM_RUN_HARD_USD=1.50`, `HSS_ORCH_VLM_CALL_TIMEOUT_S=120`, `HSS_ORCH_VLM_TRIES=3`.

## 4. Behaviour spec

1. **Prewarm** (`prewarm.py`, from `prewarm(capture_id, tier=, expected_keyframes=)`). When `HSS_ORCH_PREWARM=1`, `spend:total < 0.8 × HSS_ORCH_MODAL_SPEND_CAP_USD`, `spend:gpu:day:<today> < HSS_ORCH_GPU_DAILY_CAP_USD`, and `blob:gpu_last_call_at` is older than 840 s (`scaledown_window` 900 − 60): `Pipeline().warm.spawn()` and `EarlyQa().warm.spawn()` (direct handles inside the deployed app; from the CLI `modal.Cls.from_name(MODAL_APP_NAME, "Pipeline", environment_name=SMP_ENVIRONMENT)`), never through `modal run`. `warm()` runs no work; the class `@modal.enter()` loads π³ + MoGe-2 (GPU) or CLIP + SigLIP (CPU) from `HSS_DENSE_WEIGHTS` (default `/vol/hf`, SD-59) and returns `{enter_s, model_load_s, gpu}`. Measured cold L4 `enter_s` is 24–50 s and the cold-call overhead 73 s against 0.1 s warm (`bench-l4.jsonl` rows 2–3, 7); the 22:28 benchmark saw every call boot (30–76 s overhead) with `scaledown_window=900` and weight load 15–22 s after the image pin, so prewarm is what keeps hosted-architecture §3 "queue + container" at p50 2 s and is not optional (SD-33). Record `enter_s` per stage attempt in `run/timings.json` so the warm-hit rate is measurable; WS-12 flips `HSS_PIPELINE_MIN_CONTAINERS=1` when the first e2e runs show it below 80 %. Account `enter_s × rate("L4")` plus a flat $0.34 keep-warm reserve (900 s × $0.000380/s from `internal/modal-pipeline/app.py` `GPU_PRICES_USD_PER_S`, `CPU_USD_PER_S`, `MEM_USD_PER_GIB_S` and `bench.py::rate`) to `spend_usd.gpu` `[default chosen]`. One prewarm per capture (`blob:prewarm:{capture_id}`).
2. **Early workers** (`early/dispatch.py`, from `dispatch_early`; Modal functions with `retries=modal.Retries(max_retries=2, initial_delay=2.0, backoff_coefficient=2.0)`, fire-and-forget, `SMP_SERVICE_NAME=early-worker`, results in `blob:early:{capture_id}:*` and `captures/{id}/early/`). Why they exist: Grok 4.7 meter reads take median 41 s / p90 78 s and are the per-house wall-time floor (B3 §4 and §7.5; B2 §7), so meter and panel reads start at file commit, never after finalize; the CPU gate (CLIP ViT-B/32 0.08 s + SigLIP2-base 0.30 s ≈ 0.4 s per frame on one core, ~50 CPU-s for a 129-frame house) runs before any VLM call and cuts API calls from ~134 to ~30 and cost from $2.32 to ≈ $0.30 per house (B3 §1, §4). Job names are WS-00's `EarlyJobName`.
   - `early_reads(capture_id, file: CommittedFile)`: for `role: still`, or a keyframe whose `meta.keyframe.purpose` is set, with purpose in `{meter_close, meter_oblique, panel_close, panel_open, main_disconnect}`; at most 6 per capture (2 meter + 4 panel) `[default chosen]`. Inputs per B2 §7: the close-up at original resolution with EXIF intact, no geometry (`read_still` fetches `file.key` through `Storage`: `uploads/…` before promotion, `captures/…` after, SD-30). Calls `server.reads.read_still(StillRef, storage, ReadsConfig(timeout_s=HSS_ORCH_VLM_CALL_TIMEOUT_S, tries=HSS_ORCH_VLM_TRIES))` (WS-08: meters GPT-5.5 + Grok 4.7 in parallel at 2048 px, `detail: high`; panels GPT-5.4-mini first, escalating hazard, unprinted brand and amp claims to GPT-5.5; B3 §1, B2 §4); for `meter_close` WS-08's result also carries the meter identity and WS-08 writes `early/meter_identity.json` (SD-46; WS-05's `scale` stage reads it from `reads/reads.json` or that blob). Per-call timeout 120 s, 3 tries (B2 §7: "Grok 4.7 p90 is 78 s; set about 120 s and fall back to GPT-5.5 alone plus confirm") `[default chosen]` over hosted-architecture's 90 s; function timeout 420 s. Publishes every returned `Hint` as a `hint` event (incl. the `meter_number_confirm` hint whose `HintData.confirm` carries the candidates, SD-51); writes `early/reads/{still_id}.json`. A single-model result is `unconfirmed`, never auto-filled (B3 §3.1: GPT-5.5 + Grok 4.7 agree 65/68 correct, Wilson low 87.8%, below the 95% bar). Error codes pass through: `vlm_timeout`, `vlm_parse_error`, `provider_quota` (B2 §7). Skipped when `VISION_EXTERNAL_CALLS=off`.
   - `early_qa(capture_id, paths)` (class `EarlyQa`, CPU, `cpu=2`, `@modal.enter()` loads open_clip ViT-B/32 LAION-2B and SigLIP2-base-256 from `/vol/hf`, `scaledown_window=600` `[default chosen]`): batches of ≤ 10 committed images; per frame Laplacian variance on a 1024-px downscale and luminance stats (`blur_var < 60` blurry, `mean_lum < 40/255` dark, `> 215/255` or clipped share `> 0.15` bright `[default chosen]`) plus `server.objects.gate.score_frame(rgb) -> GateScores` (WS-07: zero-shot class scores, SigLIP reading-probe score). B3 §4: sharpness ranks blur at AUC 0.75, "good enough to rank frames and prompt a retake, not to drop frames", so QA never drops a frame. Emit `frames_blurry` only for a checklist still or ≥ 3 consecutive blurry keyframes `[default chosen]`; write `early/qa/{frame_id}.json`. Selection (CLIP ∪ SigLIP top-2 frames per class per house, B3 §3.2) happens in the `objects` stage, which first scores any frame without a QA record (photo flow commits everything at the end).
   - `capture_check(capture_id)`: debounced to one run per 2 s per capture `[default chosen]`; no image download. Checklist items: `server.packet.capture_check(partial, mode="partial")` on the committed `meta` records (WS-02 §16). Pose-frusta coverage (WS-03): meter position = 1.0 m along the `meter_close` keyframe's viewing axis (spec §3.4 "head-on from about 3 ft"), wall normal = that axis, ground = 1.4 m below the epoch's first pose (spec §2: 1.2–1.6 m) `[default chosen]`; stations every 0.5 m along the wall line to ± 7.92 m from the meter (contract §6.1 reach); a wall station is *seen* when ≥ 2 keyframes at 1–8 m and ≤ 75° incidence hold it inside the central 94% of the frame; the ground strip 0–4.27 m out is *seen* when ≥ 2 keyframes pitched ≥ 20° below horizontal cover it `[default chosen]`. Emit `wall_gap_left|right` when ≥ 2 consecutive stations stay unseen after the walk has passed them, `ground_not_seen_*` when that side's walk exceeds 5 m with no downward frame, and `capture_check` whenever `missing` changes or every 10 s while frames arrive; `complete = (missing == [])`; `meterRead` from the `early_reads` blob. A `capture_check` must land ≤ `CAPTURE_CHECK_TARGET_S` (30 s) after the last commit (plan WS-03 "done when"; hosted-architecture §3).
3. **Finalize → run** (`start_run(capture_id, packet_sha256, packet_uri, parent_run_id=)`, called by WS-01's `on_finalized` hook once the packet is accepted and every listed file is promoted to `captures/`): read `CaptureRecord` (`flow`, `tier`); create `RunRecord` (idempotent on `run_id = "run_" + sha256(packet bytes)[:16]`, the id WS-01 already returned; `branch = lidar` when any keyframe carries `depth.file` + `depth.confidenceFile`, else `image`; `profile_default = RULES_PROFILE_DEFAULT`; `deadline_at = now + HARD_STOP_MIN`) and `blob:run_control:{run_id}`, eleven `StageRecord`s `pending`, `coordinate_run.spawn(run_id)`, `state.set_status(capture_id, processing)`, event `stage {validate, pending, 0, runId}`; then the finalize-time `capture_check(mode="final")` event (adds `meter_tap`, `door_view_meter_side` when `scaleReference.ext.doorOnMeterSide != false` and `ext.doorViews == []`). A repeat `start_run` with the same SHA returns the existing run and re-spawns the coordinator only if `coordinator_heartbeat_at` is older than 180 s. Amendments (`parent_run_id` given): `RunRecord.parent_run_id`, parent artifacts exposed as `inputs["parent/<key>"]`; `poses` uses `parent/poses/sparse/0/` as `base_model` (WS-04 §4.15); `scale` reuses `parent/scale/scale.json` when its `status == "verified"` `[default chosen]`.
4. **Coordinator** (`coordinator.py::coordinate_run`, CPU, `timeout=1560`, `retries=0`, `SMP_SERVICE_NAME=pipeline`; single writer of transitions). Loop every 5 s: (a) `ready` = pending stages whose required deps are `done` and optional deps are terminal; (b) for each: `attempt = failures + respawns + 1`, `gpu = spec.gpu_by_attempt[min(attempt, 3) − 1]` (`["L4", "L4", "A100-40GB"]`: the plan's "second retry escalates"), spawn `Pipeline.with_options(gpu=gpu)().run_stage.spawn(run_id, stage, attempt)` or `run_cpu_stage.spawn(...)`, record `StageRecord.worker_call_id`, `started_at`, `running`, emit `stage running`; (c) poll each running call with `FunctionCall.get(timeout=0)`: success → `done`, `artifact_uri`, `RunRecord.artifacts.update(result.artifacts)`, `metrics`, add `vlm_cost_usd` to `vlm_reads` (`reads`), `vlm_objects` (`objects`, `objects_3d`) or `vlm_c3` (`criteria`), emit `stage done`; exception or `modal.exception.FunctionTimeoutError` → `failures += 1`, `error`, `error_code`; `pending` if `failures < max_attempts` and the exception is in `RETRYABLE`, else `failed`; (d) staleness: `running` with `heartbeat < now − HSS_ORCH_STALE_S` → status `stale`, `FunctionCall.cancel()`, `respawns += 1`, then `pending` if `respawns ≤ HSS_ORCH_MAX_RESPAWNS`, else `failed` with `stage_stale:<stage>`; a call older than `timeout_s` is cancelled and counted as a failure with code `timeout`; (e) `coordinator_heartbeat_at = now`; (f) `now ≥ deadline_at` → cancel every running call, `hard_stop`; (g) `cancel_requested` → cancel all, run `skipped`, no further events; (h) an optional stage `failed` → `degraded.append(stage)`, dependants run with that input absent; a required stage `failed` → §4.8; (i) when `objects_3d` is terminal and `scene` is `done`: if `objects_3d` is `done`, call `server.scene.merge_objects(scene_path, objects_3d_path)` and validate the rewritten `scene/scene.json` (`artifact_invalid:scene` on failure); then `criteria` becomes ready. On the terminal transition: `finished_at`, `blob:gpu_last_call_at`, `run/timings.json` (per-stage `started_at`, `finished_at`, `duration_s`, `enter_s`, `attempt`, `gpu`, plus `merge_objects_s`), `run/cost.json` (`spend_usd` buckets) and `run/stages.json` (`list[StageRecord]`) under `runs/{runId}/`.
5. **Workers** (`runner.py::run_stage` inside `run_cpu_stage` and `Pipeline.run_stage`): write `worker_call_id = modal.current_function_call_id()`; materialize `captures/{id}/**` (sha256 re-checked) as `inputs["packet_dir"]` and each dep's artifacts into `work_dir=/tmp/hss/{run_id}/`, reusing them when already on the container; start `Heartbeat(state, run_id, stage, call_id, period_s=HSS_ORCH_HEARTBEAT_S)` (daemon thread, writes `substep`; a `False` return means this call was superseded → raise `StageSuperseded` and abort); call `server.<stage>.run(ctx)` (`server.objects.run_3d(ctx)` for `objects_3d`); the stage uploads its own artifacts under `captures/{id}/runs/{run_id}/<folder>/` (WS-00 §3.9 keys, no attempt folders in storage) after writing them into `work_dir/_attempts/<stage>/attempt-<n>/`; an earlier attempt's partial upload is overwritten only by a later successful attempt, and readers follow `RunRecord.artifacts` `[default chosen]`; return the `StageResult`. Test hooks: `HSS_ORCH_TEST_HANG_STAGE=<stage>:<attempts>` (sleep 400 s without heartbeats), `HSS_ORCH_TEST_FAIL_STAGE=<stage>:<code>:<n>` (raise on the first n attempts), `HSS_ORCH_TEST_KILL_COORDINATOR_AFTER=<stage>` (`os._exit(1)` right after spawning it).
6. **Sweeper** (`sweeper.py::sweep`, `schedule=modal.Period(minutes=5)`, CPU, `timeout=240`, `retries=0`, `SMP_SERVICE_NAME=sweeper`): for runs in `pending | running`: (a) `coordinator_heartbeat_at < now − 180 s` → `coordinator_respawns += 1`; re-spawn `coordinate_run` if `≤ 2` (it re-attaches to `running` stages through `modal.FunctionCall.from_id(worker_call_id)`), else `manual_review` with `coordinator_dead`; (b) `now ≥ deadline_at` → `hard_stop`; (c) `pending` for > 60 s with no coordinator → spawn one. Stale *stages* are the coordinator's job (§4.4d): a hung stage is re-spawned 180–185 s after its last heartbeat when the coordinator is alive, within one sweeper period otherwise. Prints one JSON line with the spend counters; returns the number of runs touched.
7. **Cost accounting** (`spend.py`): each stage attempt adds `client_s × rate(gpu | cpu)` to `spend_usd.gpu|cpu`, `spend:total`, `spend:day:<today>`, `spend:gpu:day:<today>`; VLM costs come from `metrics["vlm_cost_usd"]` and the early-read blobs, whose `cost_usd` the coordinator sums into `spend_usd.vlm_reads` at `start_run` so the soft baseline and hard cap below include them (SD-56; early workers themselves are capped by WS-08's `HSS_READS_BUDGET_USD_PER_HOUSE`, and inside a stage the lower of `ctx.vlm_budget_usd` and the stage's own cap wins). Measured geometry-only L4 cost is $0.05–0.15 per house (benchmark 22:28, SD-38). Per-run soft baseline `HSS_ORCH_VLM_RUN_SOFT_USD=0.30` = B3 §4's cascade (objects ≈ $0.18 as ~17 mini + ~8 GPT-5.5 confirms, meter $0.088, panels $0.031, ~30 calls; hosted-architecture's $0.75–1.8 and plan WS-07's $0.85 predate the gate); above it log `vlm_over_baseline`. Hard cap `HSS_ORCH_VLM_RUN_HARD_USD=1.50` = baseline + WS-09's C3 budget $0.60 + retry headroom `[default chosen]`: once reached, `ctx.vlm_budget_usd = 0`, stages make no further calls (WS-09 marks facts `not_evaluated`; WS-07/08 return `budget_exhausted`) and the run ends `manual_review`. Modal: refuse to spawn GPU stages once `spend:total ≥ 0.9 × HSS_ORCH_MODAL_SPEND_CAP_USD` ($180) → `spend_cap`. The counter is an estimate; the $200 workspace budget in the Modal dashboard is the real stop (SMP review §6.8).
8. **Failure → outcome** (`outcomes.py::decide`, first matching row wins; rows 1–10 are the coordinator's, rows 11–14 are executed by WS-10's `result` stage from the default-profile verdict and listed here so one table exists):

| Condition | Capture status / `failure_code` | Device outcome; event |
|---|---|---|
| `validate` failed and `packet/validation.json` `imagesUsable == false` | `failed` / `packet_invalid` | none; `failed {next: none}` |
| `validate` failed, usable images exist (hosted-architecture §3) | `manual_review` / `packet_invalid` | `manual_review`; `failed {next: manual_review}` |
| required stage exhausted (`gpu_oom`, `crash`, `timeout`, `no_model`, `scene_invalid`, …) | `manual_review` / `stage_exhausted:<stage>:<code>` | `manual_review`; `failed` |
| stale stage beyond 2 re-spawns · coordinator dead beyond 2 · deadline | `manual_review` / `stage_stale:<stage>` · `coordinator_dead` · `hard_stop` | `manual_review`; `failed` |
| `poses/registration_report.json` `status == no_meter_model` (WS-04 §4.9) | pipeline continues; end state `manual_review` / `no_meter_anchor` | `manual_review` |
| SfM fragments in the photo flow (`registered_fraction < 1`) | not an error (hosted-architecture §3): WS-06 marks other fragments unobserved | whatever the verdict says |
| `poses` `actions` or `scale/scale.json` `status ∈ {unverified, conflict}` → `memberActions` `retake_meter_closeups` / `truedepth_meter_scan` (A9; never a tape) | `needs_views` / – | `needs_more_photos`; `retake_request {memberActions}` (WS-10) |
| optional stage failed (`objects`, `reads`, `objects_3d`; e.g. both VLM providers down for 10 min) | continue without it; end state `manual_review` / `degraded:<stages>` | `manual_review` |
| VLM hard cap or Modal cap hit | `manual_review` / `vlm_budget_exhausted` · `spend_cap` | `manual_review`; `failed` |
| a produced `scene/scene.json` (also after `merge_objects`) or `verdicts/verdict.*.json` fails `python -m server.eval.cli validate` | `manual_review` / `artifact_invalid:<stage>` | `manual_review`; `failed` (never ship an invalid verdict) |
| `verdicts/verdict.<RULES_PROFILE_DEFAULT>.json` `site.decision == pass` | `complete` | `eligible`; `verdict_ready` |
| `site.decision == reject` | `complete` | `not_eligible` when `SHOW_REJECT_TO_HOMEOWNER`, else `manual_review`; `verdict_ready` |
| `manual_review` with `views_needed != []` | `needs_views` | `needs_more_photos`; `retake_request {viewsNeeded}` |
| `manual_review` with `views_needed == []` | `manual_review` | `manual_review`; `verdict_ready` |

A retry is never an outcome; it is §4.4b–d. The coordinator writes `CaptureRecord.status` through `state.set_status` and `RunRecord.failure_code` for rows 1–10 and emits `failed` once (`final_event_seq`); for rows 11–14 WS-10's `result` stage writes the status and the coordinator verifies that exactly one `verdict_ready` or `retake_request` exists, else emits `failed {code: result_no_event}`. WS-10 reads `RunRecord.degraded` and `failure_code` through `inputs["run_control"]` (a JSON dump of the run record plus the control blob).
9. **Determinism.** Order inside a parallel group is not fixed; tests assert the partial order of §8.2. Stubs use seed 0. VLM-calling stages record model, tokens and `cost_usd` per call in their own artifacts; the orchestrator sums `metrics["vlm_cost_usd"]`.

- `server/orchestrator/legacy_run_packet.py` (WS-00's move of `housepipe/pipeline.py`): reference only; its timing keys (`untar_s, validate_s, prepare_s, colmap_s, lidar_scale_s, dense_pi3_s, lidar_fuse_s, depth_s, coverage_s, total_s`) shape `run/timings.json`; never call it from the coordinator (it writes `house-scene/v0-modal`, not scene v0).

## 7. Commands

```bash
uv sync --frozen && source .venv/bin/activate                 # WS-00 tooling: uv + ruff + pytest
make fixtures ONLY=all                                       # .fixtures/packets/*.tar, data/fixtures/{scenes,labels,packets}
export STATE_BACKEND=memory STORAGE_BACKEND=local HSS_ORCH_STAGE_STUBS=1 VISION_EXTERNAL_CALLS=off SMP_ENVIRONMENT=dev
# 1. Local, no Modal: coordinator and stages in-process (CPU laptop, < 90 s per run)
python -m server.orchestrator.cli run-local --tar .fixtures/packets/eth3d-electro.tar --variant arkit-nonlidar \
    --out /tmp/hss/electro --replay-interval 0.5             # replays commits at 2 frames/s, then finalizes; prints events
python -m server.orchestrator.cli dump-run --out /tmp/hss/electro   # stage table, events, timings.json, cost.json as Markdown
pytest server/orchestrator/tests -q                          # ~2 min CPU; state contract on memory
ruff check server/orchestrator && ruff format --check server/orchestrator && uv run lint-imports
# 2. Modal env dev, stubs, CPU + one L4 warm call (~4 min, ≈ $0.50 per full run)
export STATE_BACKEND=modal_dict STATE_DICT_NAME=hss-dev-state STORAGE_BACKEND=volume MODAL_APP_NAME=house-scanning
SMP_ENVIRONMENT=dev modal deploy -m server.orchestrator.modal_functions --env dev   # same app `house-scanning` as WS-12's deploy
T=.fixtures/packets/eth3d-electro.tar; V=arkit-nonlidar
python -m server.orchestrator.cli run-modal --env dev --tar $T --variant $V --stubs
python -m server.orchestrator.cli run-modal --env dev --tar $T --variant $V --stubs --hang-stage poses:1                # §8.3
python -m server.orchestrator.cli run-modal --env dev --tar $T --variant $V --stubs --kill-coordinator-after poses \
    && modal run -m server.orchestrator.modal_functions::sweep                                                          # §8.4
python -m server.orchestrator.cli run-modal --env dev --tar $T --variant $V --stubs --fail-stage poses:gpu_oom:2 --allow-escalation  # §8.5, one A100 stub call ≈ $0.05
HARD_STOP_MIN=4 python -m server.orchestrator.cli run-modal --env dev --tar $T --variant $V --stubs --hang-stage dense:1,2,3   # §8.6
python -m server.orchestrator.cli spend --env dev            # spend:total, spend:day:<today>, spend:gpu:day:<today>
```

Runtimes: stub runs on Modal 60–90 s (a cold GPU container adds 24–50 s `enter_s` plus queue); real stages (when WS-04/06/09 land) target p50 3 min / p95 8 min from the last photo (hosted-architecture §3; WS-11 gate `time_to_verdict_p50_s_max: 180`).

## 8. Done when

Paste the gate table into the PR.

1. `pytest server/orchestrator/tests -q` green, ≥ 30 tests: WS-00's state contract on `memory` and, when `MODAL_TOKEN_ID` is set, `modal_dict`; ready-set computation for the §3 graph (`poses`, `objects`, `reads` ready together after `validate`; `scene` waits for `coverage` and a terminal `objects`; `objects_3d` waits for `scene`; `criteria` waits for a terminal `objects_3d` and the `merge_objects` call); `gpu_by_attempt == ["L4", "L4", "A100-40GB"]`; equal `run_id` for equal packet bytes, different for one changed byte; a later successful attempt overwrites, a failed one never does; staleness with a fake clock at 179 s (no) / 181 s (yes); `outcomes.decide` for every row of §4.8 (14 cases); `seq` strictly increasing under 8 concurrent emitters; hint and `capture_check` codes are WS-00's closed `Literal`s.
2. `run-local` on `eth3d-electro` `arkit-nonlidar`: events hold this partial order: `stage validate done` → {`poses`, `objects`, `reads`} `running` → `scale` → `dense` → `coverage` → `scene` → `objects_3d` → `criteria` → `result` `done` → exactly one of `verdict_ready` / `retake_request`; capture status ∈ {`complete`, `needs_views`, `manual_review`}; `RunRecord.artifacts` names every §3 key (WS-00 §3.9 paths) and each exists in storage; `python -m server.eval.cli validate` passes on `scene/scene.json` and all four `verdicts/verdict.*.json`; `sha256(verdicts/verdict.C.json)` equals what `result` read (the orchestrator never edits verdicts); `run/timings.json` (with `enter_s` per attempt), `run/cost.json` and `run/stages.json` exist.
3. Kill test (`--hang-stage poses:1`): attempt 1 shows a frozen `heartbeat`, status `stale`, cancelled 180–185 s after its last heartbeat; attempt 2 runs on `L4` and ends `done`; `metrics.respawns == 1`; one `verdict_ready`.
4. Coordinator death (`--kill-coordinator-after poses`, then `sweep`): the re-spawned coordinator re-attaches to the running `poses` call (`worker_call_id` unchanged), `coordinator_respawns == 1`, run completes.
5. Escalation (`--fail-stage poses:gpu_oom:2 --allow-escalation`): attempts 1–2 fail with `gpu_oom` on `L4`, attempt 3 has `gpu == "A100-40GB"` and ends `done`; with `poses:gpu_oom:3` the capture ends `manual_review`, `failure_code == "stage_exhausted:poses:gpu_oom"`, one `failed` event.
6. Hard stop (`--hang-stage dense:1,2,3`, `HARD_STOP_MIN=4`): capture `manual_review` / `hard_stop`; `modal app logs` show no worker alive 15 s after `deadline_at`.
7. Early-worker latency: three `run-local --replay-interval 0.5` runs on `yt-LCPBf86oloE` give `max(capture_check.at − last_commit.at) ≤ 30 s` (WS-11 `capture_check_s_max`); on the synthetic `meter_close` packet the `early_reads` blob has `started_at ≤ commit_at + 5 s`, i.e. before finalize (B3 §4, B2 §7 latency floor).
8. Idempotency: a second `start_run` with the same SHA creates no second run and no duplicate events; a second `dispatch_early` for the same path spawns no second early worker.
9. Spend: `run/cost.json` summed over the whole §7 sequence ≤ $10; `vlm_reads + vlm_objects == 0` with `VISION_EXTERNAL_CALLS=off`; a unit test asserts `HSS_ORCH_VLM_RUN_SOFT_USD == 0.30` and that `ctx.vlm_budget_usd` hits 0 exactly at `HSS_ORCH_VLM_RUN_HARD_USD`.
10. Regression gates stay green: `make validate`, `make schemas`, `make hygiene`, `uv run lint-imports` (WS-00); `validate` on every produced artifact; `score-verdicts --labels data/fixtures/labels/eth3d-electro.C.json` on the stub verdict reports 0 unsafe passes.

## 9. Validator checklist

File `internal/build/validation/ws-03.md` (frontmatter with the validator's `cursor.subagentId`; sections: commit SHA, §8 gate table with observed values, hand checks, forbidden-content greps, open issues).

1. Fresh clone, `make fixtures ONLY=all`, run every §7 command yourself against Modal env `dev` with `--stubs`; never reuse the builder's outputs.
2. `dump-run` for the kill, death and escalation runs: read the stage table by hand; `attempt`, `metrics.failures`, `metrics.respawns`, `gpu`, `error` must match §8.3–8.5 exactly; confirm `seq` strictly increases and exactly one final event exists.
3. Open `early/capture_check.json` from the `yt-LCPBf86oloE` replay and check three stations by hand against the keyframe poses (a station 6 m along the wall may be *seen* only after frames past it exist).
4. `rg -n "anthropic|claude" server/orchestrator` → 0; `rg -n "OpenAIChatGraphPooled|XAI_CHATGRAPH" server` → 0; `make hygiene` passes (size, deny-list, key patterns); no file > 5 MB in `git diff --stat main...HEAD`.
5. Compare `outcomes.py` with §4.8 row by row; a missing or reordered row fails.
6. Modal dashboard: no GPU container of this app alive 16 min after the last test; validation spend ≤ $10.
7. Fail on any §8 miss, any missing artifact, or a stage table that disagrees with the PR's pasted table.

## 10. Constraints

- Vision models: GPT-5.5 and Grok 4.7 only (GPT-5.4-mini as the cheap first tier inside WS-07/08 per B3), OpenAI and xAI endpoints only, no Anthropic anywhere including ported code. `VISION_EXTERNAL_CALLS=off` stops every external call, early workers included.
- Never commit real meter numbers (`internal/breadth/b2/labels/*`, `b2/raw/meter/*`, `b2/b3-raw/*`), Base SSR prompt text, API keys or secret values (env names only), or any file over 5 MB; fixtures and weights live in `.fixtures/` (fetched) and `/vol/hf`. `make hygiene` is the mechanical check.
- No customer tools (no tape) in any hint, `capture_check` code or `memberActions`; only `retake_meter_closeups` and `truedepth_meter_scan` (A9).
- Cost: Modal spend cap $200 total across all workstreams (the dashboard budget is authoritative; this WS stops GPU spawns at $180 and prewarm at $160); WS-03 validation ≤ $10; per-house VLM baseline $0.30 (B3 §4), hard cap $1.50 per run; GPU runs only through the §7 commands, never on push.
- Privacy: captures are personal data. Logs (WS-00 `server/common/logging.py` keys) carry ids, codes, timings and costs, never image bytes, addresses or plate text. `cancel_capture` stops work within one coordinator loop; object deletion is WS-01's `DELETE`.
- Safety invariant: the orchestrator never edits `scene.json` or `verdict.*.json`; invalid artifacts route to `manual_review`; a degraded run never ends `eligible`.

## 11. Out of scope and handoffs

- Endpoints, signed URLs, `files[]` vs committed validation, the `GET /events` long-poll transport, `DELETE`, the `StateStore` backends for captures/files: WS-01 (calls `start_run`, `prewarm`, `dispatch_early`, `cancel_capture`; serves `events_after`).
- Packet schema, normalization, checklist `capture_check` items: WS-02. Stage algorithms and artifact contents: WS-04 (`poses`), WS-05 (`scale`, meter-table lookup from WS-08's identity), WS-06 (`dense`, `coverage`, `scene`, lifting `objects.json`), WS-07 (`score_frame`, top-K selection, `objects`), WS-08 (`read_still`, aggregation, `reads.json`, read hints), WS-09 (`criteria`), WS-10 (`result`, `verdict_ready` / `retake_request`, copy table, AR anchors, APNs, webhook, reviewer view).
- Replay client, `ReplayRun.timings`, CI gates (`make e2e`): WS-11. Dockerfile, `server/modal_app.py` composition (images, `KNOBS`, registering this module by import), secrets, OTel, GPU benchmark, deployment of `Pipeline`: WS-12. `server/common/backends/state_postgres.py`: WS-12 at migration. iOS confirmation of hint and `capture_check` codes and their copy: WS-14.

## 12. Open questions and defaults

| Question | Default to assume |
|---|---|
| Who owns `Pipeline` (WS-00 §4.9 said WS-12) | decided (SD-32): WS-03 builds it on WS-00's `app` with WS-12's `GPU_IMAGE`/`KNOBS`; WS-12 composes and deploys it |
| `objects` before or after `scene` (WS-00 §3.9 vs WS-06 §3 / hosted-architecture §3) | decided (SD-08): `objects` = 2D before `scene`; `objects_3d` after `scene`; `merge_objects` called by the coordinator before `criteria` |
| Additive `StageContext`/`StageRecord`/event fields | decided (SD-17/19): carried by WS-00's contracts; no subclass, no contracts PR |
| `modal.Retries(2)` (plan) vs GPU escalation | orchestrator-managed attempts, `retries=0` on stage functions; early workers keep `modal.Retries(max_retries=2)` |
| Per-call VLM timeout: 90 s (hosted-architecture) vs "about 120 s" (B2 §7, WS-08 §7) | 120 s, 3 tries |
| `poses` timeout vs WS-04's `HSS_POSES_TIMEOUT_S` (400 s in the WS-04 brief) | the 420 s stage timeout is authoritative; `deadline_at` is in the context; `HSS_POSES_SFM_MAX_FRAMES=48` keeps the mapper inside it (SD-10) |
| OWLv2 in the cascade (plan WS-07) vs B3 no-go | no OWLv2; `objects` on CPU; move it into the GPU class only if WS-07 keeps OWLv2 |
| Ground height and meter distance before finalize | ground 1.4 m below the epoch's first pose; meter 1.0 m ahead of the `meter_close` keyframe |
| `capture_check.missing` codes (hosted-architecture example `ground_downward_w1`; WS-14 `cc.meter_closeups`) | WS-02 items + §3 pose-frusta codes with `left` / `right`; WS-14 maps them to copy |
| Default rules profile | `RULES_PROFILE_DEFAULT=C` (WS-00 `Settings`; the only name, SD-11) |
| Prewarm the CPU `EarlyQa` class too | yes, same caps |
| Degraded run whose verdict has `views_needed` | `manual_review`; the reviewer sends the retake (WS-10) |
| Modal environments | `dev` for everything in this WS; `prod` is WS-12's |
| Photos may go to OpenAI/xAI (Base decision) | `VISION_EXTERNAL_CALLS=on` in dev; when `off`, `meterRead: absent` and reads are `not_evaluated` |
